svg.title: From the detector to velocities and their power spectrum, GJ 570 A, May 2024
svg.desc: Output of the spectrograph. Each 25 s exposure gives an extracted spectrum, whose cross-correlation dip gives one radial velocity. One night of 571 velocities of GJ 570 A scatters by tens of centimetres per second around zero. The power spectrum of all 2,250 velocities shows excess power from oscillations near 4.71 mHz, periods of three to four minutes.
svg.text: night of 8 to 9 May 2024, slow drifts removed
